description: An invariant reading a constant that a server-placed function reads (`tagged` holds a `?{}` query, §12.2): E-DECL-INVARIANT-IMPURE (the constant is server-only, §7.6 (b); reading it in a check the client runs would ship it).
rationale: Ruling S483-invariant-const-read: "A `let`, a host-derived const, or a server-only const stays refused."
